comparison.objective: Insert an eject pin to release a phone SIM tray, then return the tool; candidate screens mixed solids.
comparison.physical_skill: Sub-millimetric pin insertion and bracing versus granular-flow and bridge-clearing control.
comparison.success_condition: SIM tray protrudes and eject tool is returned versus ≥98% media recovery with washers retained.
comparison.reason: The precision insertion task does not test separation.
